title: The generic root-cover model is a pullback
statement: Let i:U→L be a morphism of schemes and W→U a finite Galois G-cover [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let H→B be a ring algebra, B a domain and discrete valuation ring, g∈H with (g) prime, and B its localization at (g); assume pi, the image of g, is irreducible. Write K=Frac(B), j:Spec K→Spec B, b:Spec B→Spec H, and choose ψ:Spec H→L and k:Spec K→U such that k i=j b ψ and the square (k,id,i,j b ψ) is cartesian. Let T→Spec K be a G-cover and ρ:T→W with (ρ,T.π,W.π,k) cartesian. Write A=H[t]/(t^{|G|}-g), N=Spec A, q:N→Spec H, V=D(g)⊆N, p:W×_L V→V, a=p followed by V→N. Write A0=B[t]/(t^{|G|}-pi), q0:Spec A0→Spec B, and a0:T×_{Spec B}Spec A0→Spec A0. Let beta:Spec A0→N be Spec of the coefficient map AdjoinRoot.map. Then there exists m:T×_{Spec B}Spec A0→W×_L V such that (m,a0,a,beta) is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. No normalization, Noetherian or finiteness-of-p assumption is needed.

source.place: Tag 00PD (algebra-lemma-characterize-dvr); root-cover-normalization-cartesian step 1; generic principal open and pullback universal properties

proof.text: By associated_pow_irreducible every nonzero denominator in B divides a power of pi. IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd identifies Frac(B) with B[1/pi]. Its Spec is an open immersion of image D(pi). AdjoinRoot.map_of gives beta q=q0 b and beta inverse-image of V equals q0 inverse-image of this generic open. These statements are proved directly using Mathlib, including the localization criterion and localization_away_comap_range.

Lift a0 beta to V using its generic image. Compose the model cover projection with rho and pair it with this lift to obtain m into W×_L V; hk and hT give the compatibility equation. For any cone to a and beta, lift its Spec B projection uniquely to Spec K. The cartesian square hbranch makes the corresponding U-map the original cover projection, and hT supplies a unique lift to T. Pair that lift with the Spec A0 projection. The two open-immersion monomorphisms and both supplied pullback universal properties prove uniqueness. Thus this is a limiting pullback cone. The full lift construction and both uniqueness equations are written in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem root_cover_generic_pullback
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (H B : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra H B] (g : H)
    [(Ideal.span {g}).IsPrime] [IsLocalization.AtPrime B (Ideal.span {g})]
    [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (hpi : Irreducible (algebraMap H B g))
    (ψ : Spec H ⟶ L)
    (k : Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)) ⟶ U)
    (hk : k ≫ i = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) ≫ ψ)
    (hbranch : IsPullback k (𝟙 _) i
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) ≫ ψ))
    (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B))))
    (ρ : T.P ⟶ W.P) (hT : IsPullback ρ T.π W.π k) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ ψ)
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    let pi := algebraMap H B g
    let A0 := AdjoinRoot
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)
    let q0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A0))
    let j0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
    let a0 := pullback.snd (T.π ≫ j0) q0
    let γ := AdjoinRoot.map (algebraMap H B)
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi) (by simp [pi])
    ∃ m : pullback (T.π ≫ j0) q0 ⟶
        pullback (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ ψ),
      IsPullback m a0 a (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom γ))
